title: MSC Source Entry
description: Schema of an entry stored in msc-api/sources.json. A source represents a piece of content generated by an LLM (modelResponse) or provided directly by the user (userText), tagged and routed to an external MSC server.

receivedAt.description: Server-side ISO 8601 timestamp. Stamped by msc-api, never sent by the client.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of this entry. Stamped server-side. Bump on breaking shape changes.

modelResponse.description: Text of the LLM response being saved.

userText.description: Text provided directly by the user, without a model response in between.

usedModel.description: Identifier of the LLM that executed the msc_source tool (provider/model).

title.description: Short auto-generated title, useful for listings and SEO.

language.description: BCP-47 / ISO 639-1 language code of the content (e.g. es, en).

prompt.description: Original user prompt that produced modelResponse, kept verbatim (no auto-generation, no normalization).
